quests.instruction: Listen carefully, then select the word you hear.
quests.hint: For 'think,' place your tongue tip lightly between your teeth; for 'sink,' pull it back behind your top teeth without touching them.
quests.explanation: The speaker said "think." The /θ/ is made with the tongue tip touching the edge of the upper teeth. "Sink" would pull the tongue back to make a hissing /s/ instead, without touching the teeth.
quests.vowelTensionRule: For /θ/, the tongue tip pokes out gently between the teeth. For /s/, the tongue stays fully behind the teeth. Neither sound uses the voice.

quests.vowelTensionRule: /θ/ lets air hiss continuously between the tongue and teeth. /t/ fully blocks the air, then releases it in one quick burst.
